description: Codex-only install surface used for dry-run planning, validation, and collision review. Profiles select the base operation set; every resolved plan uses the canonical operations-array order, with optional Git guards and curated skills completed before the terminal plugin-cache refresh. Every operation names its target: codex, claude, or shared (runs once for any selected target).

operations.summary: Install durable global Codex guidance.
operations.conflictPolicy: Global guidance can affect every repo. External repos keep precedence through repo-local AGENTS.md files.

operations.summary: Install Codex config template for the current platform.
operations.conflictPolicy: Canonical template plus user-owned overlay: existing model, profile, approval, sandbox, project trust, and unrelated MCP values are preserved outside Force. AgentChef-managed agent/MCP safety tables are synchronized explicitly; Force replaces the file only after backup.

operations.summary: Install the profile launcher used to compose managed MCP profiles.
operations.conflictPolicy: The launcher is a managed local helper and is replaced only after backup when force or update synchronization is explicitly selected.

operations.summary: Install the lazy project-keyed Serena pool bridge.
operations.conflictPolicy: The bridge is local-only, starts no Serena/LSP until an allowlisted semantic tool is used, and never stores a token in repository content or config.

operations.summary: Install conservative default command-approval rules.
operations.conflictPolicy: Rules allow narrow verification commands and keep destructive/publish actions approval-gated.

operations.summary: Install specialist subagent definitions.
operations.conflictPolicy: Specialists stay narrow; do not import external repo-specific agent fleets into global defaults.

operations.summary: Install named Codex profile files.
operations.conflictPolicy: Profiles stay separate files and avoid mixing beta permission profiles with legacy sandbox settings.

operations.summary: Generate full, multi-session, and offline profiles from the installed config while preserving user overrides.
operations.conflictPolicy: Generated profiles are composed with the installed config so profile-specific MCP enablement remains current without discarding preserved user-owned config values.

operations.summary: Install the local workflow plugin bundle and its reviewed SessionEnd process-hygiene hook.
operations.conflictPolicy: Managed plugin files are refreshed after backup while extra files are preserved by default; destructive pruning requires an explicit repair flag, and Codex hook trust remains a separate exact-source user review.

operations.summary: Mirror the local workflow plugin inside the personal marketplace root.
operations.conflictPolicy: The marketplace source stays inside the marketplace root required by current Codex schema, so independently customized CODEX_HOME and AGENTS_HOME values remain portable.

operations.summary: Register the local workflow plugin in the personal marketplace file.
operations.conflictPolicy: Only the AgentChef plugin entry is added or updated after backup; unrelated marketplace plugins are preserved and invalid marketplace JSON fails closed.

operations.summary: Optionally install global Git ignore rules.
operations.conflictPolicy: A foreign existing ignore file fails closed unless AdoptGitIgnore is explicitly selected; adoption records exact prior file state in the Git-guard receipt before replacement.

operations.summary: Optionally install a global pre-commit hook.
operations.conflictPolicy: A foreign existing hook fails closed unless AdoptGitHook is explicitly selected; adoption records exact prior hook state in the Git-guard receipt before replacement.

operations.summary: Mark the optional global pre-commit hook executable on Unix.
operations.conflictPolicy: The executable bit is changed only for the explicitly installed reviewed hook after the Git-guard opt-in.

operations.summary: Optionally set global Git core.excludesfile.
operations.conflictPolicy: A conflicting core.excludesfile value fails closed unless AdoptGitExcludesFile is explicitly selected; the receipt records whether the key existed and its exact prior value before mutation.

operations.summary: Optionally set global Git core.hooksPath.
operations.conflictPolicy: A conflicting core.hooksPath value fails closed unless AdoptGitHooksPath is explicitly selected; the receipt records whether the key existed and its exact prior value before mutation.

operations.summary: Install the pinned upstream skills into the AgentChef plugin marketplace source, so both CLIs list them with the bundled skills under one plugin.
operations.conflictPolicy: Only locked package/skill pairs are allowed. Unmarked, foreign, or locally drifted same-name targets are preserved and skipped by default. A valid AgentChef provenance marker permits a mandatory-backup managed upgrade; replacing any other exact target requires a separately reviewed per-skill --adopt-existing invocation.

operations.summary: Refresh an already-installed AgentChef plugin cache when its version is stale.
operations.conflictPolicy: The cache helper only refreshes the managed plugin when Codex reports it installed and stale; missing Codex or an uninstalled plugin produces no cache write.

operations.summary: Install the AgentChef working agreement as a Claude Code user-level rule.
operations.conflictPolicy: User-level rules load in every Claude Code session before project rules. The user's own CLAUDE.md is never edited; removing this one file removes the agreement.

operations.summary: Install the shared Serena bridge launcher for the Claude Code MCP entry.
operations.conflictPolicy: The bridge keeps its state under CODEX_HOME/serena-pool so Codex and Claude Code share one lazy Serena backend.

operations.summary: Append reviewed permission rules to Claude Code settings.json and record them in a receipt.
operations.conflictPolicy: Existing keys, rules, hooks, and ordering are preserved. A rule already present in a stricter list is never re-added below it. Only entries listed in the receipt are removed on --remove.

operations.summary: Add the context7 and serena MCP servers to the user-scope .claude.json when they are absent.
operations.conflictPolicy: A server that already exists under the same name is left exactly as the user has it. No other .claude.json key is read or written; only the entries listed in the receipt are removed on --remove.

operations.summary: Write the Claude Code marketplace manifest next to the shared plugin source tree.
operations.conflictPolicy: The manifest is generated in full from the repository; it lists only the AgentChef plugin and reuses the Codex marketplace source tree.

operations.summary: Register the marketplace and install the plugin through the claude plugin CLI.
operations.conflictPolicy: Claude Code's plugin cache is owned by the claude CLI; AgentChef never writes ~/.claude/plugins/*.json by hand. Without the CLI the commands are printed for later.
